T&S Communications.why: passive optical interconnect maker for cloud / AI data centers: says it is a core MPO/MTP connector supplier whose high-density fiber connectors and fiber-routing flexible boards are widely used in large data centers at home and abroad; North America is its main revenue source
T&S Communications.evidence: T&S Communications 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026): 'a core MPO/MTP connector supplier ... high-density, high-speed optical interconnect products'; optical device sales to North America RMB 619,555,515.12

players.product: MPO/MTP high-density fiber connectors, fiber-routing flexible boards (shuffle boxes), MT and ceramic ferrules, PLC/AWG chips and optical modules / AOCs for cloud data centers

quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 1.001 billion, up 20.81% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 176 million, up 1.71%. The company said net profit grew more slowly than revenue mainly because USD depreciation against RMB in H1 2026 produced FX losses, versus FX gains a year earlier.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 1.001 billion (+20.81% YoY); net profit RMB 176 million (+1.71% YoY)

quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical device products in H1 2026 (output exceeded stated capacity, both up YoY): revenue RMB 958,899,886.28 at a 35.23% gross margin versus 38.77% a year earlier. The company said the gross margin dipped on customer revenue mix, product structure and USD exchange-rate moves.
quarterly_data.figure: optical device revenue RMB 958,899,886.28; gross margin 35.23% (38.77% in H1 2025)

quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: one of the world's main high-density optical connectivity manufacturers and a core MPO/MTP connector supplier. In H1 2026 it expanded capacity of core products through a newly leased plant to ease capacity tightness and support large orders; subsidiary Tesilu's self-developed MT ferrules in several specifications completed development and are in volume supply.

quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: order volumes from its top core customers kept rising and it won new high-value customers at home and abroad; it made staged progress in development, market introduction and volume ramp of ultra-high-fiber-count, high-density optical products, and designs custom shuffle boxes based on fiber-routing flexible boards for growing customer demand.

quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: North America is the main revenue source: optical device sales to North America RMB 619,555,515.12 (32,680,557 units). Export revenue RMB 699,398,692.32 (+2.71% YoY); domestic revenue RMB 301,512,843.97 (+104.38% YoY).
quarterly_data.figure: North America optical device sales RMB 619,555,515.12; export revenue RMB 699,398,692.32 (+2.71%); domestic RMB 301,512,843.97 (+104.38%)

quarterly_data.quarter: T&S Communications half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management view on the industry in H1 2026: overseas cloud providers kept adding compute clusters and mid- to high-end optical device orders were ample, while supply-chain capacity bottlenecks constrained delivery capability to some degree.
